reasoning.text: Reproducibility is bounded by the architecture-specific details the spec itself flags as reproduction-chosen: the two impls converge on every math parameter but diverge on the bank/offset addressing, twist placement, and radix-4 recurrence, and the actual conflict-free permutation, twiddle addressing and FSM are simply absent. Fidelity is high on parameters (q, N, 8 BUs, 14-bit, Barrett mu/k, psi/omega/N^-1 all match the reference exactly) but the system's defining contributions are not reproduced — the 'conflict-free' mapping is a guess that fails per-stage, and the quantified 33%/20% op reductions and ~50% hardware saving are neither matched nor modeled.
gaps: [operation] The actual paper bank-index and offset functions plus the per-stage crossbar permutation sigma_s that achieves true conflict-freedom for all radix/stride combinations
[operation] Twiddle ROM addressing function f(stage, block) and concrete table layout (only a seed table is implied)
[control] Schedule/FSM states, transitions and loop bounds for the rearranged loop structure
[param] Derivation/accounting that yields exactly the claimed 33% mult and 20% add/sub reductions (overall vs per-BU basis)
[timing] Confirmed pipeline cycle counts (mult 3 / add-sub 1 / Barrett 4 / reg 1 currently flagged 'reproduction defaults pending the paper')
[control] Inter-stage data ordering under the parallel-8-BU schedule that yields natural order without a bit-reversal pass
[param] Confirmation that the transform is negacyclic and the canonical primitive root (currently 'implied' / reproduction-chosen)
